newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM Oct, Dec silver futures rise by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM Oct, Dec silver futures rise by daily limit.

text.p: Yen-based October and December silver futures contracts on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) rose by the daily limit of six yen per 10 grams at the opening on Tuesday, traders said.
The sharp gains in yen-based silver futures were attributable to hefty gains in New York overnight and the yen's slight weakness against the dollar, traders said.

"The spreading view that spot silver has found a floor prompted trade houses to cover shorts actively. Distant months in silver futures are likely to be glued to their daily limits for most of the day," an analyst at a commodity broker said.

Benchmark December gold futures were up 16 yen per gram in early morning at 1,356 yen. Benchmark December platinum was up eight yen at 1,362 yen. Benchmark December palladium was two yen higher at 470 yen.
